_schema_note: These end-to-end runs used the core panel only (no --adaptive), so 'sim_hits' are core-panel counts. When --adaptive is used, similarity hits are reported split into core-panel (independent evidence) vs adaptive-panel (high by construction). 'sim_hits' and 'concordant' here predate the primary-target exclusion and 4-state agreement reporting; current runs additionally exclude the intended primary target from off-target metrics.
